summary: Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Mesa Visa Royalties, LLC and affiliates to acquire mineral and royalty interests in Texas and New Mexico. Consideration comprises ~$44M cash plus 6,929,000 OpCo Common Units and equal Class B Units exchangeable for Kimbell Common Units, implying a mixed cash-and-stock deal. The filing does not disclose a board recommendation or advisor. Units are issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2). Watch for regulatory closing conditions and adjustments; risk-arb focuses on exchange mechanics and asset valuation.
